summary.text: Heavenly Ghost Concealment is an immortal killer move Fang Yuan activates. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable then ignores him.

claims.text: Under Heavenly Ghost Concealment, Fang Yuan moves past Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s countless hands, reaches Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, and deals a huge blow with a fierce killer move.

Among the many modified killer moves, heavenly ghost concealment is the first to be completed. Since the battle in Crazed Demon Cave where Fang Yuan’s ghostly concealment was restrained, he had the thought of modifying it. When his heaven path attainment level rose rapidly and he had stealing heavenly secret, he modified ghostly concealment into heavenly ghost concealment. Ghostly concealment itself was at rank nine, so there was not much improvement. After adding in heaven path Gu worms, the previous targeted methods against ghostly concealment became ineffective.

Fang Yuan’s body is covered by a layer of dark translucent armor, and a pale white bone mask covers his face. That is the manifestation of heavenly ghost concealment. Different from obscured heavenly secret, heavenly ghost concealment’s aura is surging, but it seems completely non-existent to Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable uses many methods in a row, and they are all ineffective towards Fang Yuan’s heavenly ghost concealment.

Fang Yuan has to continue maintaining rank nine killer moves, heavenly web protection veil and heavenly ghost concealment. Hidden by heavenly ghost concealment, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable thinks the two venerables have attacked instead.

In the battle over the heaven path dream realms, Fang Yuan reveals heavenly ghost concealment among new killer moves. He uses heavenly ghost concealment to become half an alliance mate of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable.
